newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in dull market.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midday on Monday in a dull market looking for fresh leads in the afternoon session, dealers said.
"There was nothing traded at all this morning. It was boring, dull. There simply were no buyers around to perk up the market," a rubber trader in a foreign commodity house said.
The Japanese market also failed to inspire the market despite higher values in Tokyo, where the key August contract rose 1.3 yen to 151.5 in the first afternoon session.
Kobe's August contract inched up 0.3 yen to 150.9.
"We're looking for leads this afternoon. Maybe, we'll run into some more covering by players in the market," another dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, April RSS3 was indicated at 121.00-123.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 122.00 cents.
April RSS1 was indicated at 172.00-174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21-$1.22) a kg from the previous 173.25 cents.
April TSR20 was indicated at 168.00-170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.18-$1.20) a kg from 168.50 cents.
